title: Annotatio VI §.III open: Classis II Patristica — parallel to Classis I
pass_a_gloss: §. III. The SECOND CLASS of Arguments is PATRISTIC, parallel to the Arguments of the first Class, and therefore deservedly to be enlisted under it.
pass_b_english: §.III opens the second class of arguments: patristic.
It runs parallel to Class I and is enlisted under it.
source_text: §. III. SECUNDA CLASSIS Argumentorum PATRISTICA est, Argumentis primæ Classis parallela, ac proinde isti meritò succenturianda.
